purpose: Controlled vocabulary for review before any database changes

groups.prompt: What do you want to accomplish?

tags.label: Find a job
tags.definition: Help with finding work, applications, interviewing or employer connections.

tags.label: Change careers
tags.definition: Help exploring or moving into a different occupation or field.

tags.label: Return to work
tags.definition: Support explicitly addressing re-entry after time away from paid work. General unemployment does not establish this specialization.

tags.label: Advance into leadership
tags.definition: Develop leadership or management capability. Does not assert executive eligibility.

tags.label: Build skills or earn a credential
tags.definition: Learn a skill or prepare for a documented credential. The tag does not promise credential issuance.

tags.label: Explore or start a business
tags.definition: Explore an idea, validate a market or launch a business.

tags.label: Grow a business
tags.definition: Improve or expand an operating business.

tags.label: Find business funding
tags.definition: Access or prepare for business capital. Availability and eligibility require separate evidence.

tags.label: Build professional connections
tags.definition: Meet peers, mentors, employers or business collaborators.

groups.prompt: What kind of help is available?

tags.label: Training & education
tags.definition: Structured teaching, workshops, courses or guided learning. A workshop may also be an event.

tags.label: Coaching & advice
tags.definition: Personalized mentoring, advising, consulting or feedback.

tags.label: Job search & employer connections
tags.definition: Application support, interview preparation, recruitment events or links to employer opportunities. Not a promise of placement.

tags.label: Networking & community
tags.definition: Peer connections, meetups or ongoing professional communities.

tags.label: Incubation & acceleration
tags.definition: A source-described incubator, accelerator or equivalent structured venture-development program.

tags.label: Funding & financial assistance
tags.definition: Grants, lending, investment access, tuition support or preparation for these. Record the exact funding mechanism separately.

tags.label: Workspace & prototyping
tags.definition: Access to physical workspaces, labs, equipment or prototyping services.

tags.label: Resources & tools
tags.definition: Directories, guides, portals or tools that help a person navigate options.

groups.prompt: What would you like to learn or work on?

tags.label: Artificial intelligence
tags.definition: Learning, applying or developing artificial intelligence, including generative AI and machine learning. A passing mention of an AI partner or tool is insufficient.

tags.label: Data & analytics
tags.definition: Collecting, analyzing, interpreting, visualizing or engineering data. Do not infer this topic from AI alone.

tags.label: Software, IT & cybersecurity
tags.definition: Software development, networks, computer support and information security.

tags.label: Digital workplace skills
tags.definition: Basic computing, office applications and practical digital literacy.

tags.label: Leadership & communication
tags.definition: Managing people, collaboration, workplace communication and leadership practice.

tags.label: Project & process management
tags.definition: Planning and managing projects, programs, delivery or operational improvement. Preserve exact methods in text.

tags.label: Business planning & strategy
tags.definition: Business models, customer discovery, business plans and operating strategy.

tags.label: Marketing & sales
tags.definition: Finding, engaging and retaining customers, brand strategy and sales.

tags.label: Finance & financial literacy
tags.definition: Accounting, budgeting, financial planning and capital readiness. Distinguish personal and business contexts in text.

tags.label: Product design & commercialization
tags.definition: Designing, testing, prototyping or bringing products and research to market.

tags.label: Technical & occupational skills
tags.definition: Practical occupational training, including equipment, manufacturing, trades and care-related technical competencies. Use industry and specific source text for narrower meaning.

groups.prompt: Is there a relevant industry focus?

tags.label: Manufacturing & hardware
tags.definition: An explicit manufacturing, materials or physical-product industry focus.

tags.label: Mobility & transportation
tags.definition: An explicit automotive, mobility, transport or logistics focus.

tags.label: Energy & environment
tags.definition: An explicit energy, clean technology or environmental industry focus.

tags.label: Healthcare & life sciences
tags.definition: An explicit healthcare, care-delivery, medical or life-sciences focus.

tags.label: Software & digital technology
tags.definition: An explicit software, IT or digital-technology industry focus. Using software alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Education
tags.definition: Serving education organizations or education-sector work. Being a college provider alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Government & public service
tags.definition: Serving public-sector careers or public-sector organizations. Public sponsorship alone is insufficient.

tags.label: Retail, food & local services
tags.definition: An explicit local-commerce, retail, food, hospitality or neighborhood-service focus. City location alone is insufficient.

groups.prompt: Who is this designed to serve?

tags.label: Individuals & professionals
tags.definition: An individual can seek this opportunity directly; verify any additional requirements.

tags.label: Founders & aspiring entrepreneurs
tags.definition: People exploring or building a new venture.

tags.label: Business owners & operators
tags.definition: People responsible for an operating business.

tags.label: Employers & teams
tags.definition: Services procured or arranged by organizations for employees or teams.

tags.label: Students & enrolled learners
tags.definition: A source explicitly addresses enrolled students or degree-seeking learners. Separate suitability from an enrollment requirement.

groups.prompt: If relevant, where is the business?

tags.label: Exploring an idea
tags.definition: Idea exploration before a defined venture or validated business model.

tags.label: Starting & validating
tags.definition: Developing a business model, product or initial market validation.

tags.label: Operating & growing
tags.definition: An operating business improving its operations, customer base or viability.

tags.label: Scaling & expanding
tags.definition: A source explicitly targets expansion, second-stage businesses or scaling.
